Definition: Whether an official government web portal or mobile application exists where taxpayers can file tax returns and pay taxes online with direct e-payment capability linked to instant payment system.
Comments: Eswatini has a tax digital service channel via the ERS TaxPal mobile application (official ERS app for managing tax accounts/services), indicating existence of a tax portal/app for tax administration services.

Comments: P2B merchant payments exist via mobile money (e.g., MTN MoMo Merchant) and e-Mali “Pay Store” feature for paying at registered outlets; EPS Fast Payments also positions for making payments for goods/services in real time.

Definition: Whether the instant payment system supports direct person-to-person transfer of funds between individuals for informal transactions, remittances, and interpersonal value transfers.
Comments: P2P payments are available via mobile money and fast payments. EPS Fast Payments supports wallet-to-wallet and account-to-account transfers; Instacash provides P2P transfers; Eswatini Mobile e-Mali allows sending money to any mobile number in Eswatini.

Definition: Whether legal or regulatory requirements obligate payment service providers to notify users, regulators, and/or data protection authorities about payment data breaches, cybersecurity incidents, or unauthorized access within specified timeframes.
Comments: Eswatini’s Data Protection Act includes breach notification obligations: the law requires data controllers to notify the Commission and data subjects in the event of an unauthorised data security breach (mandatory breach notification).

Definition: Whether national data protection or privacy legislation exists and explicitly covers payment transaction data, including provisions on data collection, storage, sharing, retention, and user rights over their payment data.
Comments: Eswatini has a comprehensive Data Protection Act (No.5 of 2022) in force (from 4 March 2022) providing general personal data protection across sectors (public/private).

Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: Eswatini has a domestic instant/fast payments system via the Eswatini Payment Switch (EPS) Fast Payments module, launched Dec 2024, enabling real-time “domestic fast payments” (up to E50,000) and interoperability across banks and non-banks (account↔wallet and wallet↔wallet).
